description: On the bed in front of you are a gray plastic tray with ice pieces inside, a purple scoop beside it, and a yellow cup on the right. The right hand holds the yellow cup and moves it leftward over the tray, tilting the cup downward to dump ice into the tray, while the left hand steadies near the tray and lightly touches its rim; then the right hand lifts the cup back upright and moves it slightly away.
